seo.title: QuizFree — Free flashcards & exam practice
seo.description: Build flashcard sets in seconds, review right before you forget with spaced repetition, and practice with 5 study modes. Completely free.
seo.libraryDescription: Discover and duplicate public flashcard sets from the QuizFree community. Free study and exam practice.
seo.searchDescription: Search public flashcard sets on QuizFree.
seo.sharedSetDefaultDescription: View and study "{title}" on {appName} — free learning and exam practice.

landing.subtitle: Create flashcard sets, study in multiple modes, and review cards at the optimal time — inspired by Quizlet, built for performance.
landing.featureModesDesc: Flashcard, Learn, Write, and Test — pick what fits your goal.
landing.featureSm2Desc: Review cards right before you forget them.
landing.featureLibraryDesc: Discover and duplicate sets shared by the community.

study.needCards: Add at least one card before you start studying.

praise.perfect2: A perfect 100% — your memory is on fire.
praise.perfect3: Not a single miss. Keep that streak going!
praise.great1: Great job! You know almost the whole set.
praise.great2: Excellent! Just a few cards left to master.
praise.great3: Well done! One more pass and you’ll have it all.
praise.half1: Past the halfway mark — keep it up!
praise.half2: Nice work! Review the missed cards to level up.
praise.half3: You’re improving steadily. One more round!
praise.quarter1: A solid start! Every review adds a little more.
praise.quarter2: Don’t give up — memory takes time to settle in.
praise.quarter3: Study a bit every day and you’ll see the difference.
praise.start1: The first step is the hardest, and you’ve taken it!
praise.start2: Every review helps you remember longer. Keep going.
praise.start3: Give it another round — you’ll notice the change.

settings.title: Customize session
settings.subtitle: Pick a mode and configure practice rounds — {count} cards ready.
settings.drawDisabledHint: No "new word" cards in this set — Write characters mode is disabled.
settings.startFailed: Could not start the study session

modes.flashcardDesc: Flip cards to review terms and definitions, with in-browser pronunciation.
modes.learnDesc: Smart multiple-choice rounds that help you memorize faster.
modes.writeDesc: Type the correct answer to train recall and spelling.
modes.testDesc: A mixed exam with multiple choice, true/false, and typed answers.
modes.drawDesc: Practice Chinese characters with interactive stroke guidance.
modes.gravityDesc: Type answers fast to destroy falling vocabulary meteors before impact.
